cash.read: Profits fail to translate into cash. Over FY22–FY26, only 28% of reported profit became operating cash flow, with negative free cash flows in four years due to expanding inventory.

bull.point: Order book expanded to an all-time high of ₹28,900 crore as of Q2 FY27, providing multi-year revenue visibility.

evidence.quote: Our order book stands at ₹28,900 crore, providing multi-year revenue visibility

bull.point: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue surged 143.6% year-on-year to ₹2,541.79 crore, with net profit expanding to ₹394.22 crore.

evidence.quote: Consolidated profit after tax in Q2 FY27 rose to ₹394.22 crore, as compared to ₹71.92 crore in Q2 FY26
Consolidated revenue surged to ₹2,541.79 crore, increasing by approximately 143.62% year￾on-year and by 32.73% over the previous quarter

bull.point: Export contribution to overall revenues increased sharply to 41.36% in FY26, up from 12.23% in FY25.

evidence.quote: Consequently, our export revenues have increased to 41.36% in FY26, compared to 12.23% in FY25, underscoring the growing contribution of global markets to our overall business
